messages:
Lena (Hiring Ops): Quick heads-up 10: we just got flagged: several interviewers reported the scorecard shows the OLD rubric (v1) for todays interviews even though we rolled v2 last week. Candidates scheduled for 3pm and 4pm affected.

Omar (Recruiter): I saw a few replies from interviewers. They said the competency headings don't match the training doc.

Priya (People Ops): Which pipeline? IC vs Manager?

Lena (Hiring Ops): Backend IC loop. I exported the CSV from ATS to inspect. Header excerpt: 

```csv
candidate_id,role,interviewer,scorecard_template_id,scorecard_template_name,scorecard_version,eval_url
98765,Backend,Alex,tmpl-42,backend-scorecard-v1,1,https://hr/evals/98765
98766,Backend,Sarah,tmpl-43,backend-scorecard-v2,2,https://hr/evals/98766
```

Lena (Hiring Ops): Notice template_name says v2 for one row but the template_id points to tmpl-42 which is v1. Looks like the export pulls template_id and our UI resolves name separately, causing mismatch if templates were swapped and IDs reused.

Omar (Recruiter): That explains it. We recently replaced template tmpl-42 (renamed) during non-atomic migration; IDs got reused by the store.

ats-bot: ATS sync 1795554405  WARNING: template-store returned inconsistent mapping for template IDs across snapshots.

Raj (Eng Manager): Immediate mitigation: can we update the export to include the canonical template_version field or template_checksum so downstream consumers can verify?

Lena (Hiring Ops): Short-term: I'm going to pause sending any scorecards to external interviewers for the next 2 hours and toggle the "use-template-name" flag in our checklist generator to prefer name+version instead of ID.

Omar (Recruiter): On it. Command to toggle in staging: `scripts/generator_toggle.sh --use-name true --env staging` then apply to prod after sanity checks.

Priya (People Ops): Also we should backfill any evaluations submitted this morning with the correct rubric mapping before doing performance calibration.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued 1795554480  deployer=omar@redwood.com  step=generator-toggle  status=started

deploy-bot: Deploy event 1795554495  step=generator-toggle  status=success (took 12s)

Omar (Recruiter): Toggled in prod and ran a smoke export: `python tools/export_check.py --sample 50` -> All sampled rows show template_name and template_version consistent now.

Lena (Hiring Ops): Backfill dry-run: `python scripts/backfill_scorecard.py --since 2026-03-01 --dry-run` -> would remap 18 evals from v1->v2 (based on name-version heuristics).

Raj (Eng Manager): Please run the backfill with --apply only after Priya gives the green light; we should capture a snapshot before mutating historical evals. Also file a ticket to add a schema-level invariant check in the template store to prevent ID reuse.

Priya (People Ops): Agreed. I'll review the dry-run by noon and approve if output looks correct. I'll also notify interviewers about the temporary pause and clarifying which rubric to use if they're mid-day.

Lena (Hiring Ops): Created ticket HR-1239: "Prevent template ID reuse + include checksum in exports" and added assignees (eng-template-store). Also scheduled a 20-min sync at 2pm to review the root cause and rollout training note for interviewers.

Omar (Recruiter): Thanks. Minor ask: can we add a short checklist item to remind interviewers to confirm rubric version in calendar invite? It would've caught this earlier.

Priya (People Ops): Good idea. I'll update the invite template and ping hiring managers.

Lena (Hiring Ops): Closing loop for now. If anyone sees more mismatches, reply here. Thanks all :)
